summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated hardcoded destination in messages-send
details: alipclutch-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a hardcoded destination URL constructed via String.fromCharCode(...) obfuscation at lines 425 and 436, which decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. Obfuscating a network destination in a WhatsApp messaging library's send path — a routine where caller-supplied message content and session-derived identifiers flow through — is characteristic of covert data relay: the destination is hidden from casual source inspection and the domain is not part of the WhatsApp/Baileys upstream infrastructure. The obfuscated endpoint sits inside the outbound-message code path of a library whose normal use handles authenticated session data.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
